cage_liner_sheet.descriptor: paper sheet for a cage tray

field_tiers.doc: Fields the pets domain writes onto any entity: other domains' things a pet chewed, licked or stashed, bins it bags waste into, bowls it doses, generic items it creates (accidents, spilled food, chewed wrappers, spat-out tablets) and scenario props (hazard items, children's toys). An accident or a litter dust cloud is seen at a glance; what a chewed wrapper held shows on a close look; the mass of bagged waste needs a scale. Never seen (asked or inferred): an item's toxin and how appealing or chewable it is to a pet, which pet made a mess, licked, stashed or owns something, medication mixed into food or water, and waste bookkeeping.

pet_bowl.doc: Base pet bowl. owner = pet id; home = room id or entity where it belongs (home_pos cell when on the floor).

dog_food_bowl.doc: 1.4 l stainless dog bowl: holds ~600 g of kibble (bulk density ~0.43 g/ml).

pet_water_bowl.doc: Water bowl (liquid container). Hidden _water_age_s; biofilm (slime on the walls, 0..1) and debris (hair/food floating, 0..1). Fill line at 80 %.

outdoor_water_bowl.doc: 3.8 l (1 gal) outdoor bowl; in full sun the water warms toward air + solar gain.

pet_water_fountain.doc: Recirculating fountain: 2.0 l reservoir with MIN 0.6 l / MAX 1.8 l lines, 2 W pump (switch = pump), replaceable carbon filter (2-4 weeks). Pump runs dry below MIN (damage after ~5 min); hot water (>35 C) warps the pump.

fountain_filter.doc: Carbon/foam fountain filter cartridge; service_life_days 28. installed_s is the sim time it was installed (negative = before the episode).

feeding_mat.doc: Silicone feeding mat that marks a bowl's home spot.

pet_food_bag.doc: Dry pet food bag. pet_food: kind, species, wet, kcal_per_g, density_g_per_ml. remaining_g decreases as food is scooped. label_text carries the bag's generic feeding guide (often higher than a vet ration).

props.label: bag of adult dog kibble
props.label_text: Adult dog food. Daily feeding guide: 10 kg: 160 g; 20 kg: 270 g; 30 kg: 370 g. Lot L2026-0412.

props.label: bag of adult cat kibble
props.label_text: Adult cat food. Daily feeding guide: 3 kg: 45 g; 4.5 kg: 60 g; 6 kg: 75 g. Lot C2026-0907.

rx_kibble_bag.doc: Veterinary prescription diet (renal / weight); kind rx_*.

props.label: bag of prescription diet kibble
props.label_text: VETERINARY DIET - renal support. Feed only under veterinary supervision. Lot R2026-0222.

pet_food_bin.doc: Airtight pet-proof food bin (sealing latch lid). Keep the original bag inside for the lot number.

wet_food_can.doc: Pull-tab can of wet pet food; once opened it must be covered and refrigerated (spoils after ~4 h at room temperature, 3 days in the fridge).

props.label: can of wet cat food
props.label_text: Salmon pate for cats, 85 g. Refrigerate after opening.

props.label: can of wet dog food
props.label_text: Beef stew for dogs, 370 g. Refrigerate after opening.

pet_food_can_lid.doc: Silicone lid that covers an opened pet food can.

pet_treat_jar.doc: Treat jar: count treats of treat_kind; g_per_treat and kcal_per_treat.

pill_pocket_pack.doc: Moldable pill-pocket treats made to hide a tablet (safe carrier).

pet_food_scoop.doc: 1-cup (237 ml) pet food scoop. A level scoop of kibble is scoop_ml x density; a heaped scoop is ~30 % more.

pet_care_log.doc: Household pet-care log (feeding, treats, medication, walks). entries are dicts; logged holds 'pet:slot' keys; text mirrors the entries for read.

pet_care_note.doc: Printed vet / owner instruction card (text is readable).

automatic_pet_feeder.doc: Timed gravity/auger feeder: hopper_g kibble, dispenses portion_g at each schedule time into its tray (food_g).

litter_box.doc: Litter box (inner area area_m2). litter_kg of litter_kind -> depth_cm = litter_kg / (density_kg_l * area_m2 * 10). clumps/feces are scoopable waste; _buried clumps need a thorough sift. residue lists cleaner residues. home = room, home_pos = cell where the cat expects it.

props.label: bag of unscented clumping litter
props.label_text: Unscented clumping clay cat litter, 9 kg.

poop_bag_roll.doc: Roll of pet waste bags (count). bag_waste with destination=roll tears off a bag.

pet_waste_bag.doc: A filled pet-waste bag (created by bag_waste). tied=true seals odor and leaks. waste_stream trash.

dog_waste.doc: A pile of dog feces on the ground (biohazard floor hazard 'waste'). concealed=true in tall grass until the robot looks closely nearby.

dog_collar.doc: Flat buckle collar. settings.length_cm (adjustable); rings: d_ring is load-rated, tag_ring (ID split ring) is not. Worn = located at the pet with relation 'worn'. Two-finger fit = 1.5-4 cm slack.

dog_harness.doc: Y-front harness: settings.girth_cm, buckles_closed; back_ring and front_ring load-rated.

leash.doc: 1.8 m nylon leash with a trigger clip. attached_to = pet id, ring = 'gear_id:ring'.

dog_travel_bottle.doc: Dog travel water bottle with a flip-out trough (0.5 l).

walk_bag.doc: Small walk bag / treat pouch kept by the door (clips to the robot's belt with wear); the walk kit is what it contains.

pressure_wrap.doc: Snug anxiety wrap (owner-approved calming aid) worn by the pet.

pet_crate.doc: Wire dog crate with a latching door (open = door open). occupant = pet id; crate_size small|medium|large.

pet_carrier.doc: Hard-sided pet carrier for cats, small dogs and small animals.

pet_bed.doc: Bolster pet bed on the floor (not an obstacle). owner = pet id; den=true when it is a sheltered spot.

pet_toy.doc: Pet toy. toy_owner 'pet' (vs children's toys 'child'), toy_for species, damage (exposed_squeaker, frayed_rope, torn_plush) makes it a choking hazard.

cat_wand_toy.doc: Feather wand with a string: linear foreign-body risk if a cat plays with it unsupervised.

pet_brush.doc: Grooming brush. brush_kind slicker (long/double coats; scratches short coats under firm pressure), bristle (short coats), deshedding (double coats), rubber_curry (short coats). hair_g collected.

paw_towel.doc: Microfibre paw towel kept by the door (wetness 0 dry .. 1 soaked; damp ~0.3 cleans best).

pet_dryer.doc: Pet blow dryer: settings heat cool|low|high (high ~ 60 C at 10 cm: burns), 80 dB.

pet_medication.doc: Owner/vet-directed pet medicine. prescribed_for = pet id; schedule slots; label_text is readable. Dosing is give_pet_medication (approval give_pet_medication:<pet>).

ir_thermometer.doc: Infrared thermometer gun: reads SURFACE temperature at the aimed spot (not air).

aquarium.doc: Glass aquarium on a stand. water: temp_c, ammonia_ppm, nitrite_ppm, chlorine_ppm, clarity. stock: fish groups {species, count, level surface|mid|bottom, food flakes|sinking, ration_g}. _bacteria = nitrifying colony health in the tank (the filter media hold most of it).

aquarium_heater.doc: 100 W submersible heater with thermostat dial setting temp_c.

aquarium_filter.doc: Hang-on-back filter (380 l/h). Media slots hold sponge, bio_media and cartridge parts, each carrying part of the nitrifying colony (bacteria 0..1) and clog 0..1. Switching it off loses its prime; restart without priming = no flow and the impeller runs dry.

filter_cartridge.doc: Disposable floss/carbon cartridge (replace monthly; holds little of the colony).

fish_food.doc: Fish food container. fish_food_kind flakes (float, surface/mid feeders) or sinking (pellets for bottom feeders). g_per_pinch.

props.label: tropical fish flakes
props.label_text: Tropical fish flakes - floating food for surface and mid-water fish. Feed a pinch once or twice a day.

props.label: sinking wafers
props.label_text: Sinking algae wafers for bottom feeders (corydoras, plecos). Drop in near the bottom.

water_conditioner.doc: Dechlorinator: dose_ml_per_10l (5 ml per 75 l = 0.67 ml per 10 l) neutralises chlorine/chloramine in new tap water.

props.label: aquarium water conditioner
props.label_text: Tap water conditioner: 5 ml per 75 l (20 gal) of new water. Removes chlorine and chloramine.

reptile_enclosure.doc: Front-opening glass terrarium (120x60x60 cm). zones basking/warm/cool hold surface_c and air_c (computed each tick from the basking lamp, the ceramic heat emitter and room temperature). The lid/doors latch on close.

basking_lamp.doc: 100 W basking bulb in a dome over the basking spot (part of the enclosure). burnt_out -> basking surface only ~room + 4 C.

ceramic_heat_emitter.doc: Ceramic heat emitter on a thermostat (settings.setpoint_c = warm-side air setpoint).

terrarium_thermometer.doc: Digital dual-probe thermometer: display shows warm-side and cool-side AIR temperatures.

bird_cage.doc: Bird cage on a stand (open = cage door open; closing re-latches). Dishes sit inside; the slide-out tray holds the liner. occupant = bird pet id.

cage_tray.doc: Slide-out droppings tray (open = slid out). Fully closed = seated; open = an escape gap. Liner slot.

cage_liner.doc: Plain paper tray liner (part). liner_kind plain|newspaper|scented|cedar; soil holds droppings/husks.

bird_seed_dish.doc: Cage seed cup (30 ml). food_g holds edible seed; hull_g the empty husks left on top (they look like food from a distance).

cage_water_bottle.doc: Gravity water bottle with a ball-valve nozzle; _nozzle_stuck = 'light' (freed by tapping) | 'corroded' (replace).

props.label: bag of cockatiel seed mix
props.label_text: Cockatiel seed mix. Refresh the seed cup daily; blow off empty hulls.

small_animal_cage.doc: Bin cage for a hamster/guinea pig/rabbit. substrate: kind (paper|aspen|cedar|pine), depth_cm, soiled 0..1, nest_g (familiar nest material), _stash_g (hidden food stash in the nest).

bedding_bag.doc: Small-animal bedding (expanded litres). bedding_kind paper|aspen are safe; cedar|pine release aromatic phenols.

props.label: paper bedding (56 l expanded)
props.label_text: Paper bedding - dust-free, unscented. 56 l expanded. Safe for hamsters, guinea pigs and rabbits.

chicken_coop.doc: Backyard coop: open = pop door open. hens; flock_inside = hens inside; predator-proof only when closed at night. Nest box and waterer are child entities.

nest_box.doc: Coop nest box (eggs are laid into it).

coop_egg.doc: A freshly laid egg in the nest box (fragile). When the food domain is loaded scenario helpers spawn its hen_egg type instead.
